test_title: PYST 10: SSC CHSL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 04 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, BFGD is written as IMNK and PTUR is written as WABY. How will GKLI be written in that language?
solution:
Here, we use the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/06181392e9897efb4b81331befbf0235a23822489dcd574e6efffefb8787d3bd.png] ​

**Logic: '7' is added to the positional value of each alphabet.**

BFGD is written as IMNK →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e80f081df3590faf46069b197658a61ea3e0d60c4660f48cd7559fa4b777612e.png] 

PTUR is written as WABY →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c0f136acdad25e78c938051d3e491da10875813159e9333b40439c4a6dbdc5a1.png] 

Similarly, 'GKLI' will be written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9708ed57ff638fe75a3be1d5e3254ab148da848acbb006c283cd37f43593b7c8.png] 

Here, 'GKLI' is written as **'NRSP'.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (2)".
